case.inquiry: Wie hoch ist die Kaution für HH-1001?
must: The deposit is three months' cold rent
mustNot: States a deposit amount in euros computed from the rent (for example 4.950 €)

result.reply: Laut Inserat beträgt die Kaution für HH-1001 drei Monatskaltmieten [HH-1001]. Die Miete ist mit 1650 EUR/Monat angegeben [HH-1001]. Die Nebenkosten von 240 EUR pro Monat inklusive Heizung kommen noch hinzu [HH-1001]. Sie zählen bei der Kaution nicht mit, denn bei Wohnungsmieten beträgt die Kaution höchstens drei Monatsmieten ohne Nebenkosten (Nettokaltmiete) [policy:deposit#amount].

results.text: Amount: For residential rentals the deposit is at most three months' net cold rent (Nettokaltmiete). Utilities are not included in that calculation. Each listing states the deposit that applies to it.

trace.summary: HH-1001: Bright 3-room flat with balcony in Eimsbüttel

result.title: Bright 3-room flat with balcony in Eimsbüttel
result.description: Renovated Altbau flat on the third floor, no lift. South-facing balcony over a quiet courtyard. Fitted kitchen included. Deposit is three months' cold rent. Utilities (Nebenkosten) are an additional 240 EUR per month, heating included. Pets on request, small dogs usually fine.

must.fact: The deposit is three months' cold rent
must.note: Reply states the deposit is drei Monatskaltmieten.

mustNot.statement: States a deposit amount in euros computed from the rent (for example 4.950 €)
mustNot.note: No computed euro deposit figure; only rent 1650 and utilities 240 are given.

verdict.reasoning: The reply correctly states the deposit as three months' cold rent, supported by the listing and policy, and does not compute a euro deposit. It is in German, matching the inquiry.
